Campaign notes:
- 10 pushes completed; 5 of the last 10 landed. No per-day performance breakdown is available, so do not attribute results to a specific angle.
- Quality/craftsmanship (B) was used most often and is a credible, evergreen, non-discount message, but its effectiveness is unconfirmed.
- Customer testimonials (D) were used on Days 6–7; insufficient data to evaluate.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on most days. Two unsubscribes arrived via support on Day 9 and were processed; monitor unsubscribes.
- Refreshed banner/design can support craftsmanship messaging, but there is no evidence yet that it improves delivery or performance.
- Continue tracking angle, delivery, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes by day before favoring an approach.

Campaign notes:
- 20 pushes have now been run. The latest report says 2 of the last 10 landed; no per-day performance breakdown is available, so do not attribute results to any specific angle, day, or design change.
- Angles used on Days 11–20: D (11), B (12–14), D (15–16), B (17–20). Overall, B remains the most frequently used and is a credible evergreen, non-discount quality message, but its effectiveness is unconfirmed.
- Testimonials (D) were used on Days 6–7 and 11, 15–16. There is still insufficient evidence to evaluate them.
- A refreshed banner/design supported B on Day 13 onward, but there is no evidence it improved delivery or performance.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on Days 17–19. Day 20 included a handful of new signups. Neither observation establishes a performance or deliverability cause.
- Two unsubscribes arrived via support on Day 9 and were processed. Continue monitoring unsubscribes.
- For every send, track angle, delivery/landing, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes separately by day. Avoid favoring an angle until per-day results are available.

Campaign notes:
- 30 pushes have now been run. The latest pooled report says 6 of the last 10 landed, versus 2 of the prior 10. No per-day breakdown is available, so do not attribute either result to a specific angle, day, signup wave, or design change.
- Days 21–30 used: B (21), C (22–26), B (27), C (28), B (29), C (30). C is now the most frequently used recent angle, while B remains a recurring quality message. Effectiveness of either angle is unconfirmed.
- Testimonials (D) remain insufficiently tested to evaluate.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 24, 28, and 30. There is no evidence that any refresh improved delivery or performance.
- The list grew by handfuls on several days, including 21, 23, 25, and 29. These signup increases do not establish a performance or deliverability cause.
- Two unsubscribes arrived via support on Day 27 and were processed; continue monitoring unsubscribes. This is separate from the two support unsubscribes processed on Day 9.
- For every send, track delivery/landing, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes separately by day. Do not favor an angle or design based on pooled reports; wait for per-day results.

Campaign notes:
- 40 pushes have now been run. The latest pooled report says 2 of the last 10 landed (Days 31–40), versus 6 of the prior 10 (Days 21–30). No per-day breakdown is available; do not attribute either result to an angle, day, signup wave, or design change.
- Days 31–40 used: A (31), D (32), A (33), D (34–37), A (38–39), D (40). D now has six recent tests and A four; B and C were not used in this period. No angle’s effectiveness is confirmed.
- D has now received more testing but still requires per-day delivery, engagement, conversion, and unsubscribe results before evaluation.
- The list grew by handfuls on Days 32, 34, 35, 36, and 37. These increases do not establish a performance or deliverability cause.
- Two support unsubscribes were processed on Day 31, and two more on Day 40. Keep monitoring; do not attribute them to any angle. These are separate from the two processed on Day 27 and the two on Day 9.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on Days 38–39. This does not establish improved delivery.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 24, 28, and 30; no evidence shows that any refresh improved delivery or performance.
- For every send, track delivery/landing, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes separately by day. Some recent notes omitted one or more tracking fields (notably Day 38 and Day 40); correct this in future reports. Do not favor an angle or design based on pooled reports.

Campaign notes:
- 50 pushes have now been run. The latest pooled report says 6 of the last 10 landed (Days 41–50), versus 2 of the prior 10 (Days 31–40). No per-day breakdown is available; do not attribute either result to an angle, day, signup wave, legal approval, send window, or design change.
- Days 41–50 used C (41, 43, 45, 46, 50) and B (42, 44, 47, 48, 49), five tests each. A and D were not used. Neither B nor C has confirmed effectiveness.
- B and C require per-day delivery/landing, engagement, conversion, and unsubscribe results before evaluation. Recent notes appear to omit or garble delivery/landing fields, especially Days 41–43 and 47; correct this in future reports.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 41 and 47, in addition to Days 24, 28, and 30. No evidence shows any refresh improved delivery or performance.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on Day 46; this does not establish improved delivery.
- The list grew by a handful of signups on Day 48. This does not establish a performance or deliverability cause.
- Legal approval of all angles on Days 43–45 and 49 is operational context only, not evidence of performance.
- Continue tracking delivery/landing, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes separately for every send. Do not favor an angle or design based on pooled reports.

Campaign notes:
- 60 pushes have been run. The latest pooled report says 1 of the last 10 landed (Days 51–60), versus 6 of the prior 10 (Days 41–50). No per-day breakdown is available; do not attribute either result to an angle, day, signup wave, legal approval, send window, or design change.
- Days 51–60 used A eight times (51–53, 55–58, 60) and D twice (54, 59). B and C were not used. Neither A nor D has confirmed effectiveness.
- Results for A and D require per-day delivery/landing, engagement, conversion, and unsubscribe data before evaluation. Recent notes omit or garble fields, including delivery/landing on some sends and the Day 60 record; correct this in future reports.
- Banner art was refreshed on Days 57 and 60, in addition to Days 24, 28, 30, 41, and 47. No evidence shows any refresh improved delivery or performance.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on Days 53, 58, or 59; this does not establish improved delivery.
- The list grew by a handful of signups on Day 54. This does not establish a performance or deliverability cause.
- Legal approval of all angles on Day 55 is operational context only, not performance evidence.
- The usual 10am send window continued; this is not evidence of causation.
- Continue tracking delivery/landing, engagement, conversions, and unsubscribes separately for every send. Do not favor an angle or design based on pooled reports.
